content:
Last week, a number of current-generation Apple products saw significant price drops, ranging from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the latest AirPods Max 2, and the deals are still going. While those discounts remain available, Amazon just slashed the price of Apple's 2026 AirTag 2 to its lowest price ever — now available for as little as $20 per unit.

During last week's anniversary sale, we already covered several all-time low prices for the new-generation AirTag 2, but if you missed them, don't worry — prices have now dropped even further, making this the best deal we've tracked.

Amazon still has a single AirTag 2 available for as low as $24 — matching the lowest price we've seen since launch — but the 4-pack has dropped to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official retail price for a 4-pack is $99, which already works out cheaper per unit than the $29 single pack. Now at nearly 20% off, each AirTag 2 comes in at roughly $20, setting a new all-time low.

While last week many expected the $90 sale price for the 4-pack to hold throughout the major retailers' anniversary promotions, Amazon's new all-time low changes the equation — and no one knows when prices will go back up.

We've previously compared the differences between the original AirTag and this year's updated AirTag 2 — you can revisit that here — but here are the key points:

  • Precision Finding range is 1.5x farther than the previous generation
  • Built-in speaker is 50% louder than the original
  • You can "hear the AirTag 2 from up to 2x farther away"
  • Features "an industry-first set of proactive safety features designed to help prevent unwanted tracking"

New AirTag 2 features on the way

AirTag 2 drops to $20 each, just as iOS 27 and watchOS 27 are set to launch next month. For Apple Watch users, there's a nice upgrade: the Find My app will gain Precision Finding support, meaning you can use your Apple Watch with on-screen arrows and exact distance information to locate your AirTag.

watchOS 27 will also unify the Find My experience into a single app. Previously on Apple Watch, Find My was split into three separate app icons in the app list or grid view — for People, Items, and Devices respectively.

On the iOS 27 side, the Find My app gets a fresh design and interface changes that make tracking people and items easier.

Bottom line: now is a great time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at this price.

More of this week's best Apple deals:

  • AirPods Max 2 — $429 (was $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 — $190 (was $249)
  • AirPods 4 — $99 (was $129)
